name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) — Central Sector Scheme
provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_students: Family income below ₹4.5 Lakh per year

eligibility.course_type: Regular full-time UG courses in recognised institutions

application_process: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in after 12th results. Documents: Aadhaar, income certificate, 12th marksheet, bank account, caste certificate (if applicable).
renewal: Renewed annually based on academic performance (60% marks required)

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_students: Post-matriculation (Class 11 and above) enrolled in government-recognised institutions

eligibility.course_type: Class 11, 12, UG, PG, Diploma, PhD, Professional courses

benefits.amount: ₹5,000–₹20,000+ per year depending on course level
benefits.additional: Maintenance allowance, thesis allowance, book allowance

application_process: Apply through scholarships.gov.in or respective State portal. Documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, institution bonafide certificate, marksheets, Aadhaar.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minority)
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
target_students: Students from minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)

eligibility.academic: Minimum 50% marks in previous qualifying exam
eligibility.course_type: Technical and professional courses at graduate/postgraduate level (B.Tech, MBBS, MBA, Law)

application_process: Apply at scholarships.gov.in. Documents: Minority community certificate, income proof, marksheet, institution fee receipt, Aadhaar.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
provider: AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)
target_students: Girl students enrolled in AICTE-approved Diploma / Degree programs

eligibility.academic: Enrolled in 1st year of AICTE-approved Technical program
eligibility.category: Girls only (one girl per family eligible)
eligibility.course_type: B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Engineering or Technology

application_process: Apply on AICTE portal (aicte-india.org). Documents: Aadhaar, income certificate, AICTE-approved college enrollment proof.
renewal: Annual, maintain 60% attendance and pass the year

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently Abled
target_students: Students with benchmark disability (≥40%) enrolled in AICTE-approved Diploma/Degree programs

eligibility.disability_requirement: 40%+ benchmark disability as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016

application_process: Apply on AICTE portal with disability certificate from government hospital.

name: State Government Engineering Merit Scholarship (General Example — Maharashtra)
target_students: Engineering students in state government/aided colleges
General + OBC students scoring high in HSC/JEE

eligibility.academic: Top 10% in HSC Science board OR specific JEE Main rank criteria

application_process: Apply through respective State scholarship portal (e.g., Mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in for Maharashtra). Each state has its own portal.
note: Every state has its own scholarship schemes. Always check your state government's official scholarship portal.
website: Check your respective state's scholarship portal

name: Inspire Scholarship (DST — Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
target_students: Class 12 Science stream students in top 1% of board
Enrolled in B.Sc / B.S / Int. M.Sc in Natural & Basic Sciences

eligibility.academic: Top 1% in Class 12 board (or JEE/NEET top 10,000 rank)
eligibility.course_type: BSc / BS / Int. MSc in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Computer Science (pure sciences)

application_process: Apply at online-inspire.gov.in. Board toppers are notified by schools. Others apply with board rank certificate.

name: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY)
provider: Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore — funded by DST
target_students: Class 11, 12 students and 1st year UG (BSc/Int. MSc) in Natural Sciences and related disciplines

eligibility.academic: 75% in class 10 (60% for SC/ST/PWD). Aptitude test (SA/SX/SB streams).

note: KVPY is one of India's most prestigious science fellowships. Provides full fellowship for BSc+MSc if you pursue research track.
